title: Winter Peak Supplement on Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewal Loyalty Credits
content:
For a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit, the winter peak supplement depends on the largest usage in therms billed on any single energy line of the agreement: 5.00 when it is 170 therms or more, 2.50 when it is 110 or more but below 170, and no supplement below 110. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the renewal loyalty credit owed.

The peak is the single highest therm figure among all energy charge lines on the agreement's bill ledger.

| Largest therms on one energy line | Winter peak supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 170 or more | 5.00 |
| 110 to 169 | 2.50 |
| below 110 | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical ledgers)

| Largest energy line | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 170 therms | 5.00 |
| 169 therms | 2.50 |
| 110 therms | 2.50 |
| 109 therms | none |
